newsitem.title: JAPAN: Guatemala's Anacafe eyes South Korea as new market.
newsitem.headline: Guatemala's Anacafe eyes South Korea as new market.

text.p: The president of Guatemala's National Coffee Association (Anacafe) said on Thursday that the association is eyeing South Korea as an emerging export market.

"Our coffee exports to South Korea are very low at the moment, but they're increasingly interested in high quality coffee and I think there's great potential," Julio Arrivillaga told reporters in Tokyo.
He also said South Korea is interested in importing regular coffee rather than instant coffee.
Arrivillaga came to Japan for meetings with local trade houses and roasters after a similar visit to South Korea.
Anacafe estimated in November that its 1996/97 coffee harvest would be between 3.45 and 3.6 million 60-kg bags.
Guatemala exported 3.7 million 60-kg bags of coffee from the 1995/96 harvest, mainly to the United States, Germany and Japan.
